summary: Updated tomcat package fixes security vulnerabilities
details:
OpenSSL-FFM FIPS failure does not prevent start-up. (CVE-2026-74048)
Jasper JSTL plug-in implementation omits page abort (SKIP_PAGE).
(CVE-2026-74049)
TOCTOU when setting specific permissions for Unix Domain Sockets - Fix
for CVE-2026-65183 did not address APR connector. (CVE-2026-80353)
HTTP/2 trailer header cross-contamination. (CVE-2026-88041)
Possible TLS 1.3 connection failures. (CVE-2026-93446)
JNDIRealm bind credential validation fails open for non-GSSAPI SASL
mechanisms. (CVE-2026-101296)
HTTP/2 request/response mix-up after error during async processing.
(CVE-2026-101356)
